Welcome to

Caprafal Hotel & Restaurant

A 5-star rated hotel and restaurant in Skardu, near the Tourism office on College Road at Maqpoon Sar Pull. Guests rate it 4.6 out of 5 on Google from 150 reviews.

Check in from 12:00 PM and check out by 11:00 AM. Dine on site, then set out for the lakes, plains and valleys around Skardu.

Experiences

Discover Skardu and beyond

Lakes, high plains, valleys and old forts all start from the hotel. Ask the front desk to help arrange transport.

Deosai Plains

A vast high-altitude plateau of green grassland and wide skies.

Sadpara Lake

A turquoise lake framed by steep mountains, close to town.

Shangrila (Lower Kachura)

A lakeside resort with a pagoda-style building and mountain reflections.

Shigar Fort

A restored heritage fort with traditional timber and stone work.

Basho Valley

Meadows and pine forests, popular for camping in summer.

Blind Lake

Clear blue water, old trees and desert mountains.

Cold Desert

Sand dunes under snow, with the high peaks behind.

Good to know

Questions guests ask

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is at 12:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM.

How much is a room?

For Oct 31 to Nov 1 with 2 adults, Bluepillow lists PKR 10,269. Prices change by date, so call to confirm.

Is there a restaurant?

Yes, the hotel has a restaurant on site.

Is breakfast included?

Travel sites list a free full breakfast. Please confirm when you book.

Do you have family rooms?

Connecting rooms are listed. Call to check availability for your dates.

Where exactly is it?

Maqpoon Sar Pull, near the Tourism office, College Road, Skardu 16100.
